ticker_news.title: 2 Vanguard ETFs to Buy With $100 and Hold Forever
ticker_news.description: The article discusses dollar-cost averaging and recommends two Vanguard ETFs for long-term investment: the S&P 500 ETF and the Growth ETF, highlighting their low costs, diversification, and potential for steady returns.
ticker_news.author: Geoffrey Seiler

ticker_news.title: If You'd Invested $1,000 in the Invesco QQQ Trust 10 Years Ago, Here's How Much You'd Have Today
ticker_news.description: A $1,000 investment in the Invesco QQQ Trust tracking the Nasdaq-100 index would have grown to $6,280 over 10 years, representing a 20.2% annualized return and outperforming the S&P 500 by 218 percentage points.
ticker_news.author: Matt Frankel

ticker_news.title: The Best Growth ETF to Invest $1,000 in Right Now
ticker_news.description: The Vanguard Information Technology ETF offers investors a diversified approach to technology sector investing, with high growth potential but also significant risk. The ETF includes major tech companies and provides exposure to innovative stocks while minimizing individual company risk.
ticker_news.author: Jennifer Saibil

ticker_news.title: Marvell Selloff Looks Overdone as Revenue Miss Masks AI Pipeline Strength
ticker_news.description: Marvell Technology experienced a stock price drop after its Q2 earnings report, with a minor revenue miss in its data center segment. Despite the selloff, analysts suggest the decline might be overreactive, noting strong AI pipeline potential and new custom silicon design wins.
ticker_news.author: Leo Miller

ticker_news.title: Microsoft: AI Push Beyond OpenAI Could Drive Next Breakout
ticker_news.description: Microsoft is developing its own AI models (MAI-Voice-1 and MAI-1-preview) to reduce dependency on OpenAI, potentially strengthening its AI and cloud computing capabilities across Azure and Copilot services.
ticker_news.author: Chris Markoch

ticker_news.title: AI in Mining Market to Hit USD 478.29 Billion by 2032, Fueled by Automation, Predictive Maintenance, and Cloud Adoption Globally | Report by SNS Insider
ticker_news.description: The AI in Mining Market is projected to grow from USD 28.91 billion in 2024 to USD 478.29 billion by 2032, driven by automation, predictive maintenance, and cloud adoption in mining operations globally.
ticker_news.author: Sns Insider
